kurz: Fold whisked egg whites or cream into a heavy mixture so that as little air as possible is lost.
bild_im_kopf: Like folding a blanket instead of crumpling it.
was_passiert: Stirring crushes air bubbles. When folding, you cut through the mixture and lift it from below over the foam. That way everything mixes while most of the bubbles survive.
schritte: Stir in a third of the foam vigorously to loosen the mixture.
Put the rest on top of the mixture.
Cut through the middle with a spatula, run it along the bottom and lift from bottom to top.
Turn the bowl and repeat until there are no streaks left. No longer.
